destroy.title: Destroy this database?
destroy.removed: The database service, its web tools and its settings.
destroy.kept: Its data volume {{volume}} and its backups. Delete the volume later under Monitor, Storage. A new database never reuses it.

create.title: Add a {{engine}} database
create.description: It starts deploying as soon as you add it to {{project}}.
create.name: Service name
create.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores.
create.passwordHint: Leave empty and a strong one is generated for you.
create.imageHint: A fixed version only: latest or a bare major number would move on its own. Leave empty for {{image}}.
create.invalidName: Use lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores, ending with a letter or digit.
create.invalidDatabaseName: Use letters, digits, dashes and underscores.
create.invalidUser: Use letters, digits, dashes, dots and underscores.
create.invalidPassword: Use up to 256 characters, with no line breaks or other control characters.
create.invalidImage: Name a fixed version, such as postgres:18.6, or pin a digest.
